Description
National College of Ireland (NCI) is a not-for-profit, state-aided third-level education institution in Dublin. It offers full and part-time courses from undergraduate to postgraduate level. NCI's specialist areas include psychology, human resource management, data analytics, management, cloud computing, fintech, accountancy, cybersecurity, education, and finance. NCI is also known for its free public events which include the dot conf digital and web technology conference.Students can study a globally recognised degree programme in Business, IT or Psychology and kickstart the career in Ireland.- With graduate working visas of up to 2 years and over 1,000 leading multinational companies, Ireland is the perfect place to start or progress their career.- Over 96% of NCI Master degree graduates are employed within 6 months of graduating thanks to NCI award winning Careers service.- NCI supports over 1000 international students each year with 4 week welcome programme, health and wellbeing initiatives and fantastic academic support services.- NCI offers over 500 scholarships per year to international students –helping them to invest in their future.- Dublin is students' campus – experience culture, sports, shopping, food and nightlife within a few steps of NCI’s city centre location.
